title: Temporary zero rate of VAT for domestic electricity in Great Britain
text:
This measure introduces a temporary zero rate of VAT for qualifying supplies of domestic electricity in Great Britain, for the period 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.

 The rate will remain 5% on all other types of domestic fuel UK-wide.
